channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
# Relay 0.3.13
- Add a Screenshot shortcut in Settings → General. Record your own combination or choose the Command–Option–S preset. Existing shortcuts stay as configured. - Drag a crosshair to capture an area of a display. Escape cancels the selection. - Keep the screenshot open while adding arrows, freehand drawings, rectangles, and text. Move or delete marks, change colours and sizes, and undo or redo edits. - Copy the annotated image or save a PNG at the capture's original resolution. A brief confirmation appears, and the editor stays open until you close it. - Start a capture from Relay's menu-bar Screenshot option or the Take Screenshot button in Settings, even without a shortcut.
macOS requires Screen Recording permission for screenshots. Enable Relay when prompted; macOS may require reopening it. Screenshot documents stay in memory until you explicitly copy or save them. Copying follows your existing clipboard-history settings.

## Relay 0.3.12
- Clipboard items you reuse now move to the top of history when copied or pasted from Relay. Existing items are updated without adding duplicates; their content, source and saved settings are kept. - Clipboard copying checks that the content was written before direct paste starts. - Settings explain how to open Clipboard & Snippets from Relay’s menu bar if a protected password field blocks the shortcut. This release does not bypass macOS Secure Input or claim to fix the unverified field-specific shortcut issue.
For macOS 14 or later, Intel and Apple Silicon. Your library and existing settings are kept.

# Relay 0.3.11
- Click a Contacts search result once to open its card in Contacts and close Relay's command window. - Pressing Enter continues to open the selected contact. Contact results also support direct accessibility activation. - Contact searching, permissions and all other result actions retain their existing behavior.
For Intel and Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Your existing Relay library, settings and Contacts permission are preserved.
